title: Zcash developers set January target for quantum-resistant payments after ‘bunker mode’ scare
summary: The plan concerns public payments, where about seven in 10 ZEC sit. A separate wallet tool would keep balance checks from revealing which addresses belong together.

title: Trump's Iran pledge underpins crypto gains as bitcoin bears face liquidation pressure
Bitcoin steadies near $82,500 after Trump rules out Iran strike before midterms
summary: Bitcoin recovered to around $82,500 after Trump ruled out an Iran strike, but remains about 4% lower on the week, while ether has lost 9%.

title: Thailand opens door to locally listed bitcoin and ether ETFs
summary: Thailand’s new crypto rules taking effect Oct. 16. They allow Thai asset managers to launch crypto ETFs on the local stock exchange, with bitcoin and ether initially eligible.

title: UK slaps sanctions on three crypto exchanges over alleged Russia links
summary: Britain said the crypto platforms and two payment services may have helped Russia evade financial sanctions, with two handling transactions involving the Kremlin-backed A7 network.
